NOW STREAMING: Preventable Tragedy

Sheridan Gorman was murdered in the early morning hours of March 19, 2026.

A freshman at Loyola University Chicago, Sheridan set out with friends to capture the northern lights over Lake Michigan. The night ended in heartbreak when she was shot and killed by Jose Medina, an illegal immigrant from Venezuela.

This is Sheridan's story, told by the ones who loved her most.
